fill.form: V(h) = V(anchor) * (c(h)/c(anchor))^(1/beta); anchor = 19:00 for evening/night, 08:00 for early morning
fill.beta_chosen_to_match: weekday peak-hour share = CMP 2018 inner-cordon average 0.078

mendeley_coverage.note: All 8 cameras recorded only ~09:00-12:00 each day (11-18 Jan 2023). Hours outside 09-11 have no footage. Counters in the CSVs are cumulative per recording session, logged every second at ~25 frames.

method: Gunjan Chowk (Pune) hourly counts 08-20, both directions summed, all classes, give measured weekday volumes for hours 8-19.

Mendeley Pune CCTV (Alankar, Jehangir, RTO Chowk; 2023) gives hours 9-11 only; each camera is normalised to its own 09-11 mean, scaled to Gunjan's 09-11 mean, and averaged with Gunjan for those hours.

Hours 20-07 have no measured hourly volume in any source found. They are filled from TomTom 2025 hourly congestion c (travel time / night minimum - 1) by a BPR-type inversion V = V(anchor)*(c/c_anchor)^(1/beta), anchored at 19:00 (evening/night) or 08:00 (early morning). A linear volume-congestion fit over 08-19 was tried and rejected (R^2 = 0.04).

beta is not assumed: it is the single value that makes the weekday peak-hour share equal the Pune CMP 2018 inner-cordon average of 7.8% (real 24-hour cordon counts). Hours where TomTom is within 3% of the night minimum have no signal and are linearly interpolated between neighbours.

Weekend has no measured hourly volume outside 09-11 (Mendeley, flat); weekend hours are the weekday profile scaled by the weekend/weekday TomTom congestion ratio through the same inversion. All weekend hours are derived.
Shares are normalised to sum to 1. Peak/Moderate/Low are thresholds on volume relative to the busiest hour.
Validation: the weekday peak-hour share is compared with Pune CMP 2018 cordon/screen-line peak shares (6.1-9.5%, avg 7.8%).
